title: Middle East live: Outcry escalates over Israeli minister’s video of Gaza flotilla activists

contentText: Australia, New Zealand and several EU officials joined the chorus of condemnations Thursday over a video clip of Israeli Minister Itmar Ben-Gvir heckling detained activists from a Gaza-bound aid flotilla. European ⁠Council President ​Antonio Costa said he was "appalled" by their treatment and Poland summoned the Israeli envoy in Warsaw over the incident. Follow our liveblog for the latest developments.
